title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 192 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 192 - Assessment in case on Partition of a Hindu Undivided Family (1) For the purposes of this Act, any Hindu family determined to be a Hindu undivided family shall be deemed to be a Hindu undivided family until, provided information on behalf of such family, relating to the partition under this section. (2) Where, during the assessment of tax of a Hindu undivided family, it is claimed by any member of that family that a partition has taken place among the members of that family, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall, after giving notice to all the members of that family, investigate the same. (3) On completion of the enquiry, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall record the findings of the inquiry as to whether the undivided family property has been partitioned and, if any, the date on which the family was partitioned shall record. (4) Where, in case of any decision under sub-section (3), regarding the partition of the undivided family takes place after the expiry of any income year, the total income of the undivided family for the income year shall be determined as if no partition has taken place; and each member of the family or each member of the group shall be jointly or severally liable for Inco the tax payable on the assessed income of the family in addition to the tax for which he is individually liable. (5) In the case of a decision under sub-section (3), the partition of an undivided family took place in any income year, the total income of an undivided family up to the date of partition shall be determined as if no partition has taken place; and in addition to the tax for which each member of the family is individually liable, the tax payable on the assessed income of that family for the period shall be jointly or severally liable. (6) Notwithstanding anything contained in this section, if after the effected, the tax shall be recoverable from each member of the family, before the division of the family shall be jointly and severally liable for the income. (7) For the purposes of this section, the separate liability of any member or group of a Hindu undivided family shall be calculated according to his or her share of the property of the divided family allotted to him or her. (8) The provisions of this section shall, so far as may be, apply to the imposition and recovery of any fine, interest, penalty or any other sum for any period up to the date of division of the family on the application of the Hindu undivided family.
